_README: This file is managed by LazyCue (see shelley/lazycue). Do NOT edit by hand — it is the cached, machine-generated DSL for a self-healing browser test. To change behavior, edit the test description and re-run LazyCue.
description: With a mouse, a working task's dot sits in the time's place; Archive pushes it left. The server runs in workspace mode, with the idle conversation {{IDLE}} and the conversation {{WORKING}}, whose agent is busy running a command for a minute. "The row of" X is ".conversation-item[data-conversation-id=\"X\"]"; "the time" is the row of {{IDLE}}'s ".conversation-time"; "the dot" is the row of {{WORKING}}'s element with data-testid "drawer-working-indicator"; "Archive" is the row of {{WORKING}}'s button named exactly "Archive". Read boxes with getBoundingClientRect(); an element's right is x + width. On a fresh server the first load of a page takes a few seconds while the Assistant is created (the header title reads "Shelley" until then): wait for elements rather than reading the page right after navigating. On a phone-sized screen the drawer is off-canvas until the header's "Open tasks" button is clicked. To "open the drawer": click the button named exactly "Open tasks" if it is visible (on a phone it is whenever the drawer is closed: it is the header's top-left button; the drawer's own "Close tasks" button stays in the page while the drawer is off-canvas, so it says nothing about whether the drawer is open); the element with data-testid "assistant-row" should then be visible within the viewport. To "reload": the reload action. To "open the settings of" a project P: click "section[aria-label=\"P\"] a.project-select", then, in the element with data-testid "project-view", click the button named exactly "Settings" in its navigation (its <nav> element; click it even when its tab already shows); "the editor" is the region (role "region"; a <section> with that aria-label) named exactly "Edit project". To "edit project P" with a change: eval sessionStorage.setItem("editFrom", location.pathname) to remember the page; open the drawer; open the settings of P; make the change in the editor; click the editor's button named exactly "Save project"; the editor's text "Saved." should be visible; then return to the remembered page with a full load: eval (() => { window.__leaving = 1; location.assign(sessionStorage.getItem("editFrom")); return "leaving"; })(), expecting "leaving", then eval "window.__leaving === undefined && document.readyState === 'complete'" until it returns true. Perform the steps in order. 1. Navigate to /. 2. Open the drawer. 3. The time should be visible. 4. The dot should be visible. 5. The row of {{WORKING}} must hold exactly 0 ".conversation-time" elements. 6. Eval this; it must return true (right-aligned where the times are): Math.abs(the dot's right - the time's right) < 2. 7. Hover the row of {{WORKING}}. 8. Archive's computed opacity should come to not be "0". 9. The dot's computed opacity should be "1" (still shown). 10. Eval this until it returns true (left of Archive): the dot's right <= Archive's x.

steps.expression: (() => { const dot = document.querySelector('.conversation-item[data-conversation-id="{{WORKING}}"] [data-testid="drawer-working-indicator"]'); const time = document.querySelector('.conversation-item[data-conversation-id="{{IDLE}}"] .conversation-time'); const dotR = dot.getBoundingClientRect(); const timeR = time.getBoundingClientRect(); return Math.abs((dotR.x + dotR.width) - (timeR.x + timeR.width)) < 2; })()

(() => { const dot = document.querySelector('.conversation-item[data-conversation-id="{{WORKING}}"] [data-testid="drawer-working-indicator"]'); const archive = document.querySelector('.conversation-item[data-conversation-id="{{WORKING}}"] button[aria-label="Archive"]'); const dotR = dot.getBoundingClientRect(); const archiveR = archive.getBoundingClientRect(); return (dotR.x + dotR.width) <= archiveR.x; })()
